###### insurance infrastructure for software platforms

# Embedded insurance, built for the way platforms work.

Launch embedded insurance with a proven platform trusted across hundreds of implementations. Most partners reach production in less than 60 days while we handle the insurance infrastructure, compliance, claims, and ongoing optimization.

[Talk to an Expert](https://verticalinsure.com/contact-us/)

[View Developer Docs](https://docs.verticalinsure.com/)

###### the platform

## Everything required to launch and scale embedded insurance.

Vertical Insure provides the technology and operational foundation needed to offer protection directly within your existing customer experience. From quote generation and policy issuance to claims management and reporting, we handle the complexity behind the scenes so your team can stay focused on building great software.



#### Embedded User Experience

Offer protection directly within your existing registration, booking, application, and checkout flows.



#### Insurance Infrastructure

Access carrier-backed insurance products, policy administration, compliance oversight, and claims operations through a single platform.



#### Partner Portal

Monitor revenue, conversion performance, policy activity, and program health through real-time dashboards and reporting.



#### Ongoing Optimization

Improve adoption and revenue through continuous testing, performance analysis, and strategic recommendations.

###### how it works

## From transaction to protection in three simple steps.

### 1

### Offer Coverage

Coverage is presented directly within your existing customer journey at the point of transaction.

### 2

### Complete the Purchase

Customers can add protection without leaving your platform, creating a seamless purchasing experience.

### 3

### Policy Issuance & Support

Policies are issued automatically, customers receive access to their coverage documentation, and Vertical Insure manages servicing, claims, and support.

###### Built for Developers

## Launch a complete embedded insurance program with a single integration.

Our drop-in component delivers quoting, purchasing, policy issuance, and customer management directly inside your application, creating an experience that feels like a native feature – not a marketplace add-on.



### API

A clean, well-documented REST API for quoting, policy issuance, payments, and servicing.



### Drop-in Components

Drop-in UI that matches your branding – display offers, collect purchases, and issue policies with minimal front-end work.



### Professional Services

Our engineers partner directly with your team to offer paired programming, testing assistance, and hands-on guidance to launch confidently.

###### support & reporting

## Complete visibility across the entire customer journey.

The ViCoverage Customer Portal gives policyholders a seamless experience for managing coverage, filing claims, and accessing support while the Partner Portal provides real-time reporting and insights into program performance.
